description: Per-agent field-level gold. Each region is one held-out page (or page set); every fact in the region was transcribed by eye from the rendered page image, independently of the extractors (2026-11-23). Scoring: a database record in the region is a true positive if metric, commodity, location, period, the listed dims and the value (within 0.5%) match an unmatched gold fact.
